context_requirements: Expression of xanthine oxidase (XDH) and a source of reactive oxygen species (e.g. hypoxia, inflammation, or high XO substrate flux) for the inhibitor to have a measurable effect
Intact NRF2/KEAP1 antioxidant response machinery for late antioxidant gene induction
Absence of a strong constitutive oxidative-stress program that would mask the effect
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed late antioxidant or inflammatory genes at 24 h in any of the nine lines
A clear, strong transcriptional response at 6 h in all lines, which would be inconsistent with the slow, secondary nature of XO inhibition
Changes in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h that are indistinguishable from generic cytotoxic drug responses

evidence.supports: XO inhibition reduces oxidative-nitrosative stress, apoptosis and fibrosis markers in vivo
XO inhibitor reduces superoxide-mediated tissue injury
Febuxostat suppresses ROS-driven MMP expression in macrophages
Febuxostat suppresses ROS-dependent inflammatory genes including MCP-1 and CXCL10

changes: Removed PMID 11165871 from evidence: abstract describes 6-formylpterin generating ROS and inducing apoptosis, not an XO inhibitor suppressing oxidative stress; it does not support the stated claim.
